name: focus
description: Focus — a Deep Agent that observes moments of attention and builds an understanding of your work.

scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @focus/shared run build && pnpm --filter @focus/local-service run build && pnpm --filter @focus/desktop run build
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm --filter @focus/shared run build && pnpm --filter @focus/local-service run build && pnpm --filter @focus/desktop run dev
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project shared --project functions --project electron --project renderer
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.coverage: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --coverage --project shared --project functions --project electron --project renderer
scripts.build:local: pnpm --filter @focus/shared run build && pnpm --filter @focus/local-service run build
